autoUpdate.desc: Runs steamcmd app_update 2394010 before every start.

#!/bin/bash
cd /pufferpanel
export HOME=/pufferpanel

# steamclient.so must be in ~/.steam/sdk64 (Steamworks SDK Redist, app 1007)
SDK=/pufferpanel/.steam/sdk64
SW=/pufferpanel/steamworks/linux64/steamclient.so
if [ ! -f "$SW" ]; then
  echo "[pufferpanel] Downloading Steamworks SDK Redist (app 1007)..."
  steamcmd +force_install_dir /pufferpanel/steamworks +login anonymous +app_update 1007 +quit
fi
if [ -f "$SW" ]; then
  [ -L "$SDK" ] && rm -f "$SDK"
  mkdir -p "$SDK"
  cp -f "$SW" "$SDK/steamclient.so"
else
  echo "[pufferpanel] ERROR: $SW is missing, the server will not start"
fi

# PalWorldSettings.ini: start from the developer default when missing or empty
INI=/pufferpanel/Pal/Saved/Config/LinuxServer/PalWorldSettings.ini
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$INI")"
if ! grep -q '^OptionSettings=(' "$INI" 2>/dev/null; then
  cp -f /pufferpanel/DefaultPalWorldSettings.ini "$INI"
fi

# Overwrite only the keys listed in pal-values.txt (KEY<TAB>VALUE); everything else is kept
awk -v vals=/pufferpanel/pal-values.txt '
BEGIN {
  while ((getline l < vals) > 0) {
    t = index(l, "\t")
    if (t > 0) {
      n++; keys[n] = substr(l, 1, t - 1); v = substr(l, t + 1)
      if (v == "true") v = "True"; if (v == "false") v = "False"
      val[keys[n]] = v
    }
  }
}
/^OptionSettings=\(/ {
  for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
    k = keys[i]; s = $0
    p = index(s, "," k "="); if (p == 0) p = index(s, "(" k "=")
    if (p == 0) {
      q = length(s); while (q > 0 && substr(s, q, 1) != ")") q--
      $0 = substr(s, 1, q - 1) "," k "=" val[k] substr(s, q)
      continue
    }
    st = p + length(k) + 2
    rest = substr(s, st)
    if (substr(rest, 1, 1) == "\"") {
      vl = index(substr(rest, 2), "\"") + 1
    } else {
      e1 = index(rest, ","); e2 = index(rest, ")")
      if (e1 == 0 || (e2 > 0 && e2 < e1)) e1 = e2
      vl = e1 - 1
    }
    $0 = substr(s, 1, st - 1) val[k] substr(rest, vl + 1)
  }
}
{ print }' "$INI" > "$INI.tmp" && mv -f "$INI.tmp" "$INI"

set -- -port=${port} -players=${maxPlayers}
if [ "${publicLobby}" = "true" ]; then
  set -- "$@" -publiclobby
fi
if [ "${perfThreads}" = "true" ]; then
  set -- "$@" -useperfthreads -NoAsyncLoadingThread -UseMultithreadForDS
fi

# Run the binary directly (PalServer.sh does not exec it, so the stop signal would not be forwarded)
BIN=/pufferpanel/Pal/Binaries/Linux/PalServer-Linux-Shipping
[ -f "$BIN" ] || BIN=/pufferpanel/Pal/Binaries/Linux/PalServer-Linux-Test
chmod +x "$BIN"
exec "$BIN" Pal "$@"
